tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App/page background (Beige white #F6F7F0). Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, nav bars, inputs. Main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, bottom sheets, modals (pair with `shadow-lg`).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells (Beige white #ECE9DF): segmented-control track, number blocks, table header, chart panel.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (Petal pink #E0DADE).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input/select/checkbox borders and any outline that carries meaning (≥3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meta, table headers, helper text. On every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, timestamps. ≥4.5:1 on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink`-filled chips/tooltips.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Rose wash: selected list row, hovered row, lock banner.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Petal pink: selected chip/segment, info banner, soft badges, mood fill, avatar.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Lavender outline: selected chip border, highlighted card border.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Chart accent ONLY (plan lines, analysis zones, equity line). Never on UI chrome.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: PRIMARY FILL (Lavender #D5B6B9): primary buttons, FAB, locked badge, selected mood step. Text on it is `on-brand` (dark) — never white.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Deep rose for TEXT and strong marks: links, ghost buttons, active tab/nav, selected outlines, toggles, meters, focus. Text on `surface`, `bg`, `brand-100`.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill hover/pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icons/text on `brand-700` fills (checkbox tick, toggle knob).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-600` (lavender) fills — 8.3:1.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Accent: Gold/XAUUSD, Pro badge, streak, highlight markers. Fill only — text on it is `ink` (light) / `surface` (dark).

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Accent soft ground: Pro/upgrade banners, 'best trade' ribbon.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text on `gold-100`.

tokens.name: profit
tokens.usage: Positive P/L, win, Good-Win quadrant, bullish bias. Always with a + sign or ↑ icon.

tokens.name: profit-100
tokens.usage: Profit soft ground: winning day cell, win badge.

tokens.name: profit-ink
tokens.usage: Profit text on `profit-100`.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative P/L, loss, Bad-Loss quadrant, bearish bias, destructive actions. Always with a − sign or ↓ icon.

tokens.name: loss-100
tokens.usage: Loss soft ground: losing day cell, error banner, breach alert.

tokens.name: loss-ink
tokens.usage: Loss/error text on `loss-100`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, Bad-Win (lucky) quadrant, rule-near-limit, pending match. Icon/mark color.

tokens.name: warning-100
tokens.usage: Warning soft ground.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on `warning-100` and `surface`.

tokens.name: q-good-win
tokens.usage: Quality × Outcome: Good-Win (followed plan, won).

tokens.name: q-good-loss
tokens.usage: Quality × Outcome: Good-Loss (followed plan, lost) — a GOOD trade, never shown in red.

tokens.name: q-bad-win
tokens.usage: Quality × Outcome: Bad-Win (won by luck).

tokens.name: q-bad-loss
tokens.usage: Quality × Outcome: Bad-Loss.

tokens.name: dim-analysis
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Analysis (charts, bars, dots — not body text).

tokens.name: dim-planning
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Planning.

tokens.name: dim-execution
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Execution.

tokens.name: dim-risk
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Risk Management.

tokens.name: dim-discipline
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Discipline.

tokens.name: dim-emotion
tokens.usage: Dimension mark: Emotion.

tokens.name: chart-up
tokens.usage: Bullish candle body/wick in TradingView Lightweight Charts.

tokens.name: chart-down
tokens.usage: Bearish candle body/wick.

tokens.name: chart-area
tokens.usage: Fill under the equity curve.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines.

tokens.name: chart-plan
tokens.usage: Plan overlay lines (entry/SL/TP, dashed).

tokens.name: chart-actual
tokens.usage: Actual fill markers and modified SL/TP steps.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset; ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat labels, badges, chart axes, nav labels.

styles.name: overline

styles.name: num

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale. Use these steps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on mobile lists; field label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile (375px); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards / sections on desktop; page gutter ≥768px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states, page top on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small tags, calendar cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, pills, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards: none — cards are separated by `border` only.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Sticky bars, floating action button.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom nav and top app bar.
